SUMMARY AND PROPOSAL

 • In FY 2024, the total cost of contract services was $1,192,411. Under
   the cost-recovery model, CAS would ideally be compensated for the
   prior years’ total actual expense in the subsequent fiscal year
   However, this year’s request does not quite achieve that goal.

   (It is worth noting that cost-recovery will always result in a
   lower-than-actual cost to the city and county due to the time-lag.
   Losses incurred by CAS in service to the contract are mitigated by
   donor support. It is CAS’s desire to reduce, over time, the need for
   donors to subsidize these services).

 • The Shelter’s new budget reflects a loss of just over $500,000. The
   assumed total cost of contract sheltering services is approximately
   $1.45 million. If the current funding amount of $900k/year is
   maintained, the difference would be the shelter’s entire deficit.

 • Funding options can be viewed in different ways.
     o One option would be to request the full budget amount for the
        current year, totalling $1,455,073. That would be an increase of
        22% over the prior year cost of $1,192,411, or 61% over the
        prior year payment amount of $900k.
     o A full cost-recovery method would reflect a payment of
        $1,192,411, an increase of about 32% over the current payment
        of $900k. CAS would like to move this direction in the future.
